change.before: "policy exceptions were allowed in all namespaces"
change.after: "disable the policy exceptions and only allows exceptions to be created in a specified namespace"

consequence.statement: With the new defaults, policy exceptions are disabled and only allowed in a specified namespace. Existing PolicyExceptions stop being honoured unless the operator follows the upgrade guidance to keep backward compatibility.
consequence.remediation: Follow the Kyverno 1.13 upgrade guidance: explicitly enable policy exceptions and set the namespace where exceptions may be created, or move existing exceptions into that namespace.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 changes its defaults so that policy exceptions are disabled and can only be created in a specified namespace (CVE-2024-48921). Environments that rely on PolicyExceptions must follow the upgrade guidance to keep them working.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence does not name the setting whose default changed (no flag, Helm values key or namespace setting is spelled out). It only refers to 'the defaults' and to external upgrade guidance.
